title: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit 2
shortDescription: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit 2 helps define a Nintendo GameCube racing path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference racing marker within the Nintendo GameCube catalog.
Pairs a frozen GameAtlas catalog method with a direct Wikidata structured-data record.

signals.rationale: Classified for the Nintendo GameCube racing discovery path using the preserved Wikidata entity record; this remains a factual-reference workflow rather than a rating.
